title: selliguea omeiensis
intro: Selliguea omeiensis, commonly known as Taiwan spleenwort, is a species of plant in the family Polypodiaceae. It is a type of fern known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Selliguea omeiensis include its ability to scavenge free radicals, inhibit platelet aggregation, and exhibit anti-hypertensive effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
